t_advice_summary_textbox.text: the colours are in pairs (eg. yellow and red) if you pick one thats lower choose the other colour in the next round. when that colour's point goes down choose the other. say the colour out loud so you dont have to think

vb_textbox.text: there will be 2 baskets (red and yellow) and they will only show up with a certain gnome selected. EG the gnome that are pink,brown,purple and red will give the red basket and the others the yellow one. the points are really weird. the baskets points will alternate. so if you choose the red one and the points are low(0) then choose the yellow one next . when yellows points decrease right before 0 (they reach 1 or 2) then choose red. try to say the colors out loud to yourself to help remember. (red basket-> red,pink,purple,brown) (yellow->yellow,green,blue,orange) enjoy<3
